correctness.rationale: The forest is generated by an independent uniformly chosen earlier parent at each step and retaining its edge with probability α. Conditional on this forest the root labels are independent fair bits. Thus the parity character expectation is one exactly for all-even components and zero otherwise, including every odd n; the all-retained event shows positivity for every positive even n. TV to Haar on two points is the absolute parity bias divided by two. There are (n−1)! equally likely increasing trees before edge decoration, versus n! for exponential generating functions, giving q_n=n[z^n]A. Removing the least label leaves an unordered set of labelled subtrees; a cut child contributes (1−α)A, a retained child α(A+yB) and the root contributes y for y=±1, giving the formal system with unique zero-initial solution. B'(0)=1, so division and reversion at zero are valid. When α=1/3, the substitution u=tanh(B/3) gives z=3u−u^3 and A'=u'(3u/(1−u^2)); Lagrange inversion gives the displayed sum, including q_2=1/3. Its prefactor times the negative-binomial probability is 3·4^(−m); that failure count sums 2m iid geometric-failure variables with mean 1/2 and variance 3/4, so the standardized cutoff (m−1−m)/sqrt(3m/2) tends to zero and the CLT gives probability 1/2. Dividing by two gives the sharp TV constant 3/4. This is for one-time marginals and fixed α, not monotone mixing or joint uniformity. Independent replay `python3 /workspace/reproduce_reviews.py 3` matched 120 exact coefficient comparisons to the count-of-ones Markov chain (five biases, n=1..24) and 12 cubic-sum cases; the frozen verifier was read, not executed.

value.rationale: The two-state walk is the canonical test case for nonmonotone step-reinforced mixing. The exact enumeration evaluates the positive even-time defect beyond the earlier qualitative example and bounds and is available at every fixed copying probability. The cubic parameter is structurally singled out by the first nontrivial cubic inverse, and computing its exponential base and prefactor gives a sharp quantitative benchmark, not just a few exact marginal entries.
